## Screen spec (from Figma)
```json
{
 "screen": "LoginScreen",
 "figmaNode": "12:300",
 "root": {
  "type": "Column",
  "name": "Login Screen",
  "background": "color.background.primary",
  "padding": {
   "horizontal": "spacing.l",
   "vertical": "spacing.xl"
  },
  "gap": "spacing.m",
  "fill": "maxSize",
  "children": [
   {
    "type": "Text",
    "name": "Title",
    "text": "Welcome back",
    "style": "typography.heading/l",
    "color": "color.text.primary"
   },
   {
    "type": "Text",
    "name": "Subtitle",
    "text": "Log in to continue",

   {
    "type": "Spacer",
    "size": "spacing.s"
   },
   {

    "name": "EmailField",
    "props": {
     "label": "Email",
     "placeholder": "name@company.com",
     "isSecure": false
    },

   },

 ]
```

## UIKit components used
```json
[
 {
  "figma": "Button",
  "description": "Primary action button. Use one Primary per screen.",
  "props": {
   "style": {
    "figmaProp": "Style",
    "values": [
     "Primary",
     "Secondary",
     "Text"
    ]
   },
   "size": {
    "figmaProp": "Size",
    "values": [
     "S",
     "M",
     "L"
    ]
   },

    "map": {
     "Default": true,
     "Disabled": false
    }
   },

    "figmaText": "Label"
   }

  }
 },

  }
 }
]
```

## Layout primitives
- Column: `Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(<gap token>), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.Start|CenterHorizontally|End)`
- Row: `Row(modifier, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(<gap token>) | Arrangement.End | Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top|CenterVertically|Bottom)`
- Box: `Box(modifier)`
- Spacer: `Spacer(Modifier.height(<size token>)) inside Column, Spacer(Modifier.width(<size token>)) inside Row, Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f)) for weight`
- Text: `UiText(text = "...", style = <typography token>, color = <color token>)`
- padding: `Modifier.padding(horizontal = <token>, vertical = <token>)`
- background: `Modifier.background(<color token>)`
- fill: `maxSize -> Modifier.fillMaxSize(), maxWidth -> Modifier.fillMaxWidth()`
- imports: `com.company.uikit.theme.AppTheme, com.company.uikit.text.UiText`

## Token table (spec token -> code)
```
color.background.primary -> AppTheme.colors.backgroundPrimary
color.text.primary -> AppTheme.colors.textPrimary
color.text.secondary -> AppTheme.colors.textSecondary
spacing.l -> AppTheme.spacing.l
spacing.m -> AppTheme.spacing.m
spacing.s -> AppTheme.spacing.s
spacing.xl -> AppTheme.spacing.xl
typography.body/m -> AppTheme.typography.bodyM
typography.heading/l -> AppTheme.typography.headingL
```

## Designer warnings (handle with TODO comments, don't guess)
- [Decoration 12:360] hand-drawn graphic; use a UIKit Icon/Image/component, or export it as an asset
- [PromoBanner 12:370] instance of 'Promo Banner' is not in the UIKit manifest

## Task
Generate the Jetpack Compose (Kotlin) file for screen `LoginScreen`.
Required shape:
- `package com.company.login` as the first line
- `data class LoginScreenState(...)` with exactly these properties: `val email: String = ""`, `val password: String = ""`
- `@Composable fun LoginScreen(state: LoginScreenState, onEmailChange: (String) -> Unit, onPasswordChange: (String) -> Unit, onForgotPassword: () -> Unit, onLogin: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)`
  - one `on<Binding>Change: (<Type>) -> Unit` per binding, typed like its state property, and one `() -> Unit` per event: onForgotPassword, onLogin
- A private `@Preview` composable `LoginScreenPreview()` at the end of the file.
